channel.title: g3 Go API :: g3
channel.description: Auto-generated reference documentation from the Go source code. audit Request ID generation, context propagation, and structured audit logging. auth SigV4 signature verification and bucket registry. backend ObjectBackend interface and Gmail storage implementation. config YAML configuration loading, validation, and defaults. server S3 HTTP request routing, handlers, and multipart uploads. telemetry Prometheus metrics, OpenTelemetry tracing, and log correlation.
